definition: An environmental system determined by a human.
notes: The habitat is the host clade, and it is the entire content of the concept: GOLD and BacDive both organise host-associated isolates by host, and every downstream anatomical path hangs off it. HabitatMech deliberately does not ground these to animal-associated environment, because every clade would then merge onto one record and the distinction the sources are making would be lost. ENVO already has this shape at plant-, animal- and fungi-associated environment; this asks for the same pattern one level down. This is the single largest ungrounded concept in the corpus.

definition: An environmental system which is a portion of the air, water, or land surface or subsurface of an astronomical body sampled in place, and which is neither bounded by a host organism nor constituted by a constructed or operated artefact.
